items.title: Blocky 3
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
These blocky designs are colorful, cute and cool! Which pattern will you choose today?

- 21 skins

items.title: Teen TNT
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Check out these amazing teens in TNT outfits! These awesome TNT designs are in HD!

- 10 skins

items.title: Slumber Party Lifestyle
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Are you ready for a sleepover all around style? Enjoy the night and get cosy with your friends. Dazzle up the night! It's time to show off your pyjamas with Slumber Party Lifestyle!

- Includes 10 incredible pyjama skins
- Perfect for roleplaying

items.title: Redstone Demons
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Let your horns show, stay sharp, stay red, stay connected and in trend! These redstone themed outfits have limitless capabilities, perfect for all redstone nerds!

+ 10 demonic outfits
+ Unique designs

items.title: 40 Waves of the Undead
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
In the midst of a zombie apocalypse, you must fight your way through each wave of monsters in order to survive. Unlock gates to new areas in the town for every wave cleared. Only the strongest defender remains in 40 Waves of the Undead!

- Includes 4 free skins
- 40 zombie waves
- 1 boss Level
- Hundreds of zombies to destroy

items.title: Flat World Survival
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Flat World Survival is the ultimate survival challenge, you spawn with nothing but your wits and your courage! Will you take on this new adventure and discover great new things?

Includes:
- New mechanics and blocks
- New structures
- Day counter
- Lots of machines and utilities
- New mobs
And so much more!

items.title: Dragon Ship Adventure
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Let's start a new adventure on a huge Dragon Ship floating in the air waiting to get bigger. Can you explore it, find the villagers and defeat the Ender Dragon?

- Explore the ship and make friends among the villagers
- An objective book with a lot of challenges!
- A cool adventure for you and your friends!
- By Pixelusion & Hylarion

items.title: Savanna Sanctuary
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Help restore a long-lost sanctuary in the middle of an ancient savanna. In this survival spawn, you can harvest the crops left behind by the villagers, set up a market where the old one once stood, or try your luck in the mines, and make the Savanna Sanctuary your new home!

- Loot chests
- Adventurous secrets to discover
- Glider
- 4 skins
- By Meraki Studios & Pixelusion

items.title: Anime Mobs
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Do you love anime? Do you love Minecraft mobs? The Anime Mobs skin pack is perfect for you!

- Fun skins for everyone

items.title: HIDE AND SEEK PROS
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description: HIDE AND SEEK PROS are stealthy and quick. Run or hide with these epic outfits!

items.title: Sandy Resort
items.creator: Shaliquinn's Schematics
items.description: Cut loose with the latest release from Shaliquinn's Schematics! Summer is upon us and it's time to have some fun. Enter Sandy Resort, your exciting getaway from the city. Lounge in the sun, explore the islands, try our some parkour, or take flight on the elytra courses. The choice is yours and there's no wrong answer!

items.title: Vintage Teens
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Take a step back in time with the vintage teens skin pack and rock your old-school fashion fits! Show your friends at school that vintage is cool!

- 22 unique outfits
+ 2 free skins!
- By Pixelusion & Lostduckies

items.title: Secret Ultimate Base
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
While everything seems ordinary, something is out of place. Turns out, it's a secret entrance!
Find out what lies beneath the secret entrance!

- Hide from your friends right beneath their feet!
- Custom 3D modeled secret hatch!
- Openable/closeable hatch!
- By Pixelusion

items.title: Mob Suits
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: These suit styles are inspired by some of the game's favorite mobs!

items.title: Lucky Block Mini Heads
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: 'Lucky Block Mini Heads' skin pack! Who knows, with your experience these skins may even add a little luck to your next adventures.

items.title: Creeper Hoodies
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: These styles are inspired by some of the game's favorite mobs! Dress as a hip creeper!!

items.title: Starchart: Space Pirates
items.creator: We Fight Mobs Studio
items.description:
Survive in a pirate-infested asteroid belt! Build peacefully in the biodome, or raid the pirate city and mining bases. Can you piece together the code to the legendary treasure vault?

-Craft beam swords and laser blasters
-Fight custom mobs like laser turrets and mechaparrots
-Fully voice-acted story
-By AdamDJM, Cold Fusion, and Exonoesis

items.title: Guardians of Domain Lifestyle
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Time to unleash your strength and rule the biomes! Each hero has a signature ability to conquer evil. Take your gear and let everyone manifest its power. Show the way to glory and honor with the Guardians of Domain Lifestyle!

- Includes 12 heroic skins
- Perfect for multiplayer

items.title: Epic Magician Teens
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Have you always wanted to become a sorcerer who protects humanity with his powers of light, fire, water, earth? Well, wait no longer! Your time has come with the "Epic Magician Teens" skin pack in which you can become a magician and defend the Earth!

- Two free skins
- Twelve amazing skins
- Created by DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Mutant Magic
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Come and be amazed by these impressive magical creatures, each one contains a different design that you cannot miss. Explore and have fun with the variation of these characters. 

- Two totally free skins
- Fourteen Skins 
- Created by DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Warden Horror
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Emerge from the Deep Dark biome to scare everyone in Warden Horror skins. Role-play with friends in netherite armor and show off your underworld style. Bring horror and fear as you sneak inside underground caves and mines. Cause all kinds of terror and trouble as the most horrible mob around.

+ 8 monster mob HD skins

items.title: Teen Surfers
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Grab a board and catch the waves! Youth is on your side when you ride the swells in Teen Surfers skins. Gear up in board shorts or a wetsuit and role-play with friends hanging ten and having fun. Try out some of your best moves: go aerial, carve, or do a turtle roll. Cheer on your fellow extreme athletes from the beach. Hang loose and don’t wipe out!

+ 8 maverick HD skins

items.title: Teen Tourists
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Got the travel bug? Have tons of fun and see all the sights in terrific Teen Tourists skins. Load up your backpack and role-play with friends as you globe-trot all around Minecraft. Look smart and stylish as you visit cities and towns and enjoy the beautiful scenery. Who knows what cool new attractions you’ll find? Don’t forget your camera!

+ 8 pleasure traveler HD skins

items.title: Crypto Robbers
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
What secrets can you steal? Find out when you become a high-tech burglar in Crypto Robbers skins. Sneak around the city in black mask and beanie while you role-play with friends as totally techno thieves. Gear up in glowing graphic digital designs to decrypt your loot. Use your crypto skills and remember to stay ahead of the law!

+ 8 bandit HD skins
